item.title: New ProMotion Fury 1/10th Slim 2wd Front Tire
item.description: The ProMotion Fury is a LP carcass based tire specifically designed for today's carpet and turf racing facilities. The LP design provides more stability through less sidewall deflection.

item.title: New Team Associated DC10 Classic Kit
item.description: Since 1964, Team Associated has proven to be the leader in the world of competition racing, and now born from our on-road racing legacy, we have engineered the DC10 Classic that sets new standards.

item.title: New Hudy 101 Carpet Off-Road Tires
item.description: Hudy has released their new 101 Carpet Tires for 1/10th scale off-road buggies with 2wd front, 4wd front, and rear options both un-mounted and pre-mounted.

item.title: 2026 Silver State Dirt Oval Announcement
item.description: Joey Christensen has shared the information for the 2026 Silver State Dirt Oval Championships held in conjunction with the 1/8th scale off-road event.

item.title: Tyler Jones Joins WIRC
item.description: WIRC Professional RC Cars is proud to introduce & welcome their newest addition, professional driver Tyler Jones, to the factory racing team for the 2026 season.

item.title: New Inov8 3DX Carbon Car Stand
item.description: Inov8 is excited to introduce their latest product, the INOV8 3DX Carbon Car Stand.

item.title: New Serpent SRX8GTE R Electric GT Chassis
item.description: The SRX8GTE R represents the pinnacle of performance in electric GT racing, with a singular focus: to enhance speed!

item.title: New Reedy Stockstar Competition LiPo Batteries
item.description: Reedy Power, a leading innovator in high-performance electronics for R/C cars, is proud to announce the launch of their all-new Stockstar battery line. Specifically designed to meet the demanding power requirements of stock class RC car racing.

item.title: New Upgrade RC Short Course Pre-Mounts
item.description: UpGrade RC is pleased to announce four new 1/10 scale short course pre-mounted tires now available at AMainHobbies.com or your local hobby shop.

item.title: New Upgrade RC Traxxas Modified Wraps
item.description: The UPG “Apex” wrap series features five high-impact visual designs that will transform the look of your Traxxas Modified immediately.
